mapper.select: select from lab_task_evidence where task_id=#{taskId} and del_flag='0' order by submit_time,id
select from lab_task_evidence where id=#{id} and del_flag='0'
mapper.insert: insert into lab_task_evidence(task_id,evidence_type,evidence_title,evidence_url,evidence_json,submitter_id,submit_time,audit_status,auditor_id,audit_time,audit_comment,del_flag,create_by,create_time,remark) select #{taskId},#{evidenceType},#{evidenceTitle},#{evidenceUrl},#{evidenceJson},#{submitterId},#{submitTime},#{auditStatus},#{auditorId},#{auditTime},#{auditComment},#{delFlag},#{createBy},sysdate(),#{remark} from lab_task where id=#{taskId} and workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and period_lock_flag='0' and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update lab_task_evidence e join lab_task t on t.id=e.task_id set e.del_flag='2',e.update_by=#{updateBy},e.update_time=sysdate() where e.id=#{id} and e.task_id=#{taskId} and e.audit_status='PENDING' and e.del_flag='0' and t.workflow_status in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') and t.period_lock_flag='0' and t.del_flag='0'

update lab_task_evidence set audit_status='APPROVED',auditor_id=#{auditorId},audit_time=#{auditTime},audit_comment=#{auditComment},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where id=#{id} and task_id=#{taskId} and audit_status='PENDING' and del_flag='0'
